details:
TL;DR:   I've been troubleshooting a friend's avatar for nearly 2 hours before discovering the issue behind it. The avatar's FBT was not working, and it ended up being because the Thumb bones were not assigned in the Unity Humanoid rig. However, I had no error or message of any kind in Unity or the SDK Control Panel to indicate this was the issue. After a lot of Google-Fu I discovered that there used to be / is supposed to be a Control Panel error / message; "Thumb, Index, and Middle finger bones are not mapped, Full-Body IK will be disabled." This never showed up and would have saved me 2 hours of troubleshooting -_-                               
                                         
 short version: The known error; "Thumb, Index, and Middle finger bones are not mapped, Full-Body IK will be disabled" does not show up in the VRC SDK Control Panel when uploading. Unity version if 2019.4.31f1. SDK version is VRCSDK3-AVATAR-2021.09.30.16.19_Public
title: VRC SDK Control Panel not reporting an error about hand bones.
